title: PSG want £145m for Barcola - Monday's gossip
summary: PSG values Bradley Barcola at £145m as Real Madrid sets a price for Vinicius Jr and Arsenal accelerates Bruno Guimaraes negotiations. The moves reflect significant transfer activity among Europe's top clubs during the summer window.
content: Paris St-Germain want £145m for Bradley Barcola, Real Madrid set Vinicius Jr price and Arsenal to accelerate Bruno Guimaraes talks, plus more.

zh.title: PSG要价1.45亿英镑出售巴尔科拉——周一转会八卦
zh.summary: PSG将布拉德利·巴尔科拉估价为1.45亿英镑，同时皇家马德里为维尼修斯Jr定价，阿森纳加快与布鲁诺·圭马拉艾什的谈判。这些举措反映了欧洲顶级俱乐部在夏季转会窗口期的重大交易活动。

title: Japan legend Miura, 59, scores first goal since 2022
summary: Kazuyoshi Miura, the world's oldest professional footballer at 59, scored his first goal in nearly four years playing for Japanese third-tier side Fukushima United. The milestone underscores the remarkable longevity of the Japan football legend's career.
content: Kazuyoshi Miura, the world's oldest professional footballer, scores his first goal in nearly four years at the age of 59 for Japanese third-tier side Fukushima United.

zh.title: 日本传奇人物59岁的三浦近4年来首次进球
zh.summary: 现年59岁、世界最年长职业足球运动员三浦知良在为日本第三级别球队福岛联队效力期间，近4年来首次进球。这一成就突出了日本足球传奇人物职业生涯的非凡长久生命力。

title: McInnes teases Rangers signing within 48 hours
summary: Rangers manager Derek McInnes teased an imminent signing within 48 hours, marking the club's second acquisition before their season opener against Dundee United on Friday. The announcement signals Rangers' continued investment in strengthening their squad.
content: Rangers hope to announce another signing within 48 hours, with manager Derek McInnes teasing a second by the time his side open their season away to Dundee United on Friday.

zh.title: 麦因尼斯暗示流浪者队将在48小时内完成签约
zh.summary: 流浪者队主教练德里克·麦因尼斯暗示将在48小时内进行签约，这是俱乐部在周五对阵邓迪联队的赛季首战前的第二次引援。这一宣布表明流浪者队继续投资加强球队阵容。

title: Holders St Mirren visit Rangers in League Cup last 16
summary: St Mirren, the defending Premier Sports Cup champions, have been drawn to face Rangers away in the last 16, while Celtic meet Dundee United. This marks a significant fixture in Scotland's top cup competition.
content: Holders St Mirren are drawn away to Rangers in the last 16 of the Premier Sports Cup, while Celtic visit Dundee United.

zh.title: 卫冕冠军圣米伦做客流浪者队参加英超杯16强
zh.summary: 卫冕英超杯冠军的圣米伦在16强中被抽签客场对阵流浪者队，凯尔特人队则对阵邓迪联队。这是苏格兰顶级杯赛中的一场重要比赛。

title: Chiesa happy but wants new chapter at Liverpool
summary: Liverpool forward Federico Chiesa has expressed satisfaction at the club while addressing speculation over his future. His statement indicates he may be weighing new opportunities despite current contentment.
content: Liverpool forward Federico Chiesa says he is "happy" at the club amid speculation over his future.

zh.title: 基耶萨在利物浦感到满意但渴望新的篇章
zh.summary: 利物浦前锋费德里科·基耶萨对俱乐部表达了满意，同时回应了关于其未来的猜测。他的声明表明，尽管目前感到满足，但他可能在考虑新的机会。

title: Gittens keen to impress 'world-class' Alonso
summary: Chelsea winger Jamie Gittens has confirmed his role in new manager Xabi Alonso's squad and praised the Spanish tactician as "one of the best to do it." The endorsement signals manager stability in the club's planning for the season ahead.
content: Chelsea winger Jamie Gittens says he will be involved in Xabi Alonso's squad next season and describes his new manager as "one of the best to do it".

zh.title: 吉顿斯渴望给"世界级"阿隆索留下深刻印象
zh.summary: 切尔西边锋杰米·吉顿斯确认了自己在新主教练哈维·阿隆索球队中的角色，并将这位西班牙战术大师称为"最优秀的人之一"。这一赞美表明俱乐部在新赛季规划中的主教练稳定性。

title: Maynard loses York job three months after title win
summary: York City has confirmed the departure of manager Stuart Maynard, just three months after he guided the club back into the English Football League. The quick exit comes despite his immediate promotion achievement.
content: York City confirm the exit of manager Stuart Maynard, three months after he guided the club back into the English Football League.

zh.title: 梅纳德赢得冠军三个月后失去约克队工作
zh.summary: 约克城足球俱乐部确认经理斯图尔特·梅纳德离职，这距他刚刚将球队带回英格兰足球联赛仅三个月。尽管取得了直接晋升的成就，他的任期仍很短暂。

title: Female referee injured in melee during friendly
summary: A female referee was injured and forced to leave the pitch after being knocked to the ground during a friendly match. The incident underscores concerns about referee safety during competitive play.
content: A female referee is injured and has to leave the pitch after being knocked to the ground during a friendly.

zh.title: 女裁判在友谊赛混乱中受伤
zh.summary: 一名女性裁判在友谊赛中被撞倒后受伤，被迫离开球场。这一事件凸显了人们对竞争比赛中裁判安全的担忧。

title: Horkas to join Hogh at Celtic - gossip
summary: Celtic is making a record transfer offer for a striker and pursuing a Croatian goalkeeper from Spain's second division. The moves represent significant summer recruitment for the Scottish club.
content: Celtic to pay record fee for striker and closing in on Croatian goalkeeper from Spanish second tier...

zh.summary: 凯尔特人队为一名前锋提出创纪录的转会报价，并追逐来自西班牙乙级联赛的克罗地亚门神。这些举动代表了这家苏格兰俱乐部重要的夏季引援。

title: Who am I? Guess Premier League star No 6
summary: An interactive guessing game where readers try to identify a Premier League player in six attempts or fewer. Part of the BBC's daily football engagement content.

title: Gomez injury overshadows winning start for Iraola
summary: Liverpool begins the Andoni Iraola era with a commanding 4-2 victory over Sunderland, with goals from Morrison, Szoboszlai, Chiesa, and Koumas. However, an injury to Gomez during the match tempers the promising start.
content: Liverpool start life under Andoni Iraola with a 4-2 win over Sunderland thanks to goals from Kieran Morrison, Dominik Szoboszlai, Federico Chiesa and Lewis Koumas.

zh.title: 戈麦斯受伤影响伊拉奥拉首场赢球
zh.summary: 利物浦在安东尼·伊拉奥拉时代以压倒性的4-2战胜桑德兰队开局，莫里森、索博斯茨凯、基耶萨和库马斯各进一球。然而，戈麦斯在比赛中的受伤削弱了这个光明的开局。

title: Wilson makes Leeds debut in defeat by Wrexham
summary: Welsh midfielder Harry Wilson makes his Leeds United debut in their pre-season opener against Wrexham. Leeds loses 3-2 in the match.
content: Wales attacking midfielder Harry Wilson makes his first outing for Leeds United as they are beaten 3-2 by Wrexham in the club's opening pre-season game.

zh.title: 威尔逊在雷克瑟姆失利中完成利兹联处子秀
zh.summary: 威尔士中场球员哈里·威尔逊在利兹联对雷克瑟姆的季前赛首场比赛中完成英超处子秀。比赛中利兹联以2:3的比分落败。
